abstract: It has been suggested that genetic predisposing factors play a role in the development of ovarian teratomas. Familial occurrence of these tumors would support this view. Reported herein are identical twins, both of whom had a right ovarian mature teratoma. In both cases the presenting symptoms were acute torsion. The diagnosis was confirmed at laparotomy and subsequent histopathologic examination. The origin of ovarian teratomas seems to be linked to the process of parthenogenesis. This process probably involves a germ cell after its first meiotic division.
abstract_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の発生には遺伝的素因が関与しているとの指摘がある。家族内発生はこの見解を支持するものである。本報告では、いずれも右卵巣に成熟卵巣奇形腫を有し、急性捻転で発症した一卵性双生児を提示する。診断は開腹術および病理組織学的検査で確定した。卵巣奇形腫の起源は、第一減数分裂後の胚細胞による単為生殖の過程に関連すると考えられる。
